data.name: Sangamesh
data.gender_notes: Sangamesh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Sangamesh is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Sangam’ which means confluence or union. This name is often used to describe a place where two rivers meet or merge. In Hinduism, Sangamesh is also the name of a God who presides over such confluences. The name Sangamesh carries the meaning “God of Confluence” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Sangamesh usually hope their child will grow to embody god of confluence and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the unity and harmony of all things.
data.etymology: Sangamesh belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of Confluence.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sangamesh total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

data.cultural_impact: The name Sangamesh holds great cultural significance in Hinduism as it represents the idea of unity and coming together. It symbolizes the idea of merging of two things to create something greater. In Hindu scriptures, the name is often used to describe various confluences such as the confluence of two rivers, or the coming together of different gods and goddesses. It represents the idea of harmony and unity in diversity.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Sangamesh emphasizes the importance of unity and merging of opposites. It is believed that by embracing the duality of life and merging the seemingly conflicting aspects of our being, we can find inner peace and harmony. The God Sangamesh is also believed to bring blessings of unity, prosperity, and spiritual growth to those who seeking him.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Sangamesh: The one who merges or unites with the divine, attaining inner peace and harmony. In Hinduism, this name symbolizes the union of the individual self with the universal consciousness or the divine.
